_comment: M2: crop rows 80:240 of the 320x240 render (drops the sky/horizon band, keeps ground) and resize to 160x80 (WxH) -- perception/model/preprocess.py and perception/model/lane_cnn.py both read the resulting shape from here rather than hard-coding it. tools/visualize_camera_coverage.py and tools/camera_resolvability.py also read this file for their crop-rectangle overlay and CNN-resolution lane-width curve. docs/decisions.md ADR-11 finding 7: perception/dataset/camera_visibility.py's lane_is_visible/any_lane_visible still run on the full 320x240 frame, not this crop -- 'visible' and 'visible to the network' are different predicates now that this is a real crop and not a no-op placeholder, and that gap has not been closed.
